preconditions: RUN-005 is finalized and its B1/B2 pipelines, preprocessing, feature map and checksums are frozen
The same persistent ARS_D0019_HMAC_KEY identity namespace used for Group 2 is available
No Group-1 signal/outcome/category inspection occurred during development
Group-1 normalization applies the same source mappings and missingness rules without alteration
one_time_sequence: Read exact pinned D0019 source and select source group=1
Apply the frozen RDC-004 eligibility/missingness rules without looking at aggregate class balance to alter them
Create source-row Event_IDs and HMAC pseudonyms with the same identity namespace as Group 2
Apply the already-fitted Group-2 B1 and B2 preprocessing/model artifacts with no refit
Persist one-time predictions and registered metrics
Seal the result; no RUN-006 result may change RUN-005, preprocessing, eligibility, features or split policy
prohibited: Opening Group-1 nonpartition fields before RUN-005 is frozen
Retuning, refitting or recalibrating on Group 1
Changing eligibility/missingness because of Group-1 composition or performance
Using Group-1 result to select between alternative models or split policies
scientific_boundary: RUN-006 is a locked transfer test. Even a positive result is bounded to the registered D0019 source-coded endpoint and does not establish literal signal meaning or species-wide compositional syntax.
